cards.draft:
Subject: Claim for order LT-7Q2W: damaged in transit

Hello Printco,

Order LT-7Q2W (Lantern, "Oskar", shipped 2026-09-24, delivered 2026-09-29) arrived damaged in transit (dented frame). Photos attached (2). We'd like a reprint to the same address. Could you confirm, and tell us if you need anything else?

Kind regards,
Exampleco

cards.summary: Wants to change the name on an order that's already printing.
cards.preview: Kan ik de naam nog veranderen? Er staat Mila, het moet Milla zijn.
cards.draft:
Hoi Eva,

Wat vervelend! Je bestelling wordt al gedrukt, dus de naam kan helaas niet meer veranderen. Wil je dat we hem annuleren, zodat je een nieuwe kunt bestellen met de juiste naam?

Met vriendelijke groet,
cards.translation:
Hi Eva,

How annoying! Your order is already printing, so sadly the name can't be changed any more. Would you like us to cancel it, so you can order a new one with the right name?

Kind regards,

cards.summary: Asks whether we gift-wrap, for a birthday on the 14th.
cards.preview: Hi! Do you do gift wrapping? My nephew's birthday is on the 14th and I'd love it to arrive…
cards.draft:
Hi Sam,

Thank you for writing! We don't gift-wrap yet, sorry: everything is printed to order and goes straight from the printer to you.

If you order by the 7th, it should arrive in time for the 14th.

Kind regards,

cards.preview: Could the poster show her real birth date? She came early and spent her first weeks in the NICU.
Hallo, ons zoontje lag twee weken op de NICU. Kan de geboorteposter van bestelling PW-8K3D zijn echte geboortedatum krijgen?
The phone line takes a moment to answer.
